title: Trump Orders Ban on 'Artificial Intelligence' Term in Government Documents
summary:
The White House will stop using the term "Artificial Intelligence" in official documentation following a directive from President Donald Trump. He characterized the name as a "very bad" description of the technology and ordered that the label be replaced by "Super Intelligence," or "SI," in federal records.

The new terminology will be adopted in "short order" and is intended to apply to relevant agency papers as well as all other government communications. Trump specifically criticized the Wall Street Journal for its continued use of the term "AI," asserting that nearly all other organizations would soon use the SI designation.
